title: DO! NUTS TOKYO — Social Innovation Platform
jpTitle: DO! NUTS TOKYO — ソーシャルイノベーションプラットフォーム
summary: Launched DO! NUTS TOKYO, a citizen-facing sustainability sub-brand of Value Frontier supporting Tokyo's target of near-zero CO2 emissions by 2050. Led branding, digital platform design and workshop facilitation, designing frameworks that generated sustainability proposals from youth ambassadors across three cohorts. Won the 2021 American Graphic Design Award.

angles.business: The brand DNA built for Value Frontier's own corporate repositioning was reapplied to a public-facing civic platform — evidence the underlying brand work was durable enough to carry into a different institution and audience entirely.

mine: Applied the brand DNA developed in the Value Frontier project to a citizen-facing sustainability platform

narrative.problem: To hit near-zero CO2 emissions by 2050, Tokyo needed more than policy — it needed a platform that could engage citizens, corporations and especially youth in sustainability, making climate action feel accessible, creative and participatory rather than bureaucratic.
